title: Follow-stack executor
description: `nx serve <app>` — follows the app's running dev stack (`<app>:dev-stack`, which it depends on with every flag forwarded) and ends when the stack ends, with the stack's exit status: non-zero, with the engine's account of which process died and why, when the stack failed. Every option is the stack's; this target reads none of them.

project.description: The served app. Defaults to the project this target is attached to.
